research_notes_other.research_findings: Searches did not yield specific details on featured cases. Based on list info and general knowledge, the documentary profiles Bryan Stevenson and EJI's mission. It likely uses several cases EJI handled, with Walter McMillian's case being a cornerstone example of their work fighting wrongful convictions on death row in the racially biased Southern justice system. The film contextualizes individual cases within the broader history of racial inequality in America.
